state.task: Finish this bounded code review. Preserve supported distinct defects and accurately scope their impact. Do not claim whole-repository completeness.
contracts: DaemonSet replica counts use desired scheduled pods, even when none are ready.
Distinguish a demonstrated local failure from an unverified downstream recovery consequence.

findings.message: The readiness guard rejects DaemonSets with desired scheduled pods but no ready pods. For DesiredNumberScheduled=5 and NumberReady=0, this function returns an error instead of the required replica count of 5. Restore the DesiredNumberScheduled zero guard.
findings.evidence: Lines 151–152 check ds.Status.NumberReady == 0 and return an error. The supplied contract requires counting desired scheduled pods even when none are ready.

findings.message: Returning NumberReady produces an incorrect replica count when readiness differs from desired scheduling. For DesiredNumberScheduled=5 and NumberReady=2, this function returns 2 instead of 5. Return DesiredNumberScheduled.
findings.evidence: Line 154 returns int(ds.Status.NumberReady), nil; the diff replaces the previous DesiredNumberScheduled return. A positive NumberReady passes the guard, so this defect occurs independently of the zero-ready error.

state.coverage: Verified the existing finding against the supplied diff, source lines 138–159, and contracts. Coverage is limited to the shown DaemonSet replica-count logic.
limitations: Caller behavior was not supplied; downstream recovery failure is unverified.
No test diff was supplied, so removal of a zero-ready regression test cannot be verified.
No tools were used or tests run; whole-repository completeness is not claimed.
